errors.text: The critical transition is not identified as approximately 673 K; instead, a broad 600–800 K interval is proposed.
The heating protocol is substantially incorrect: 10–50 K/s to 1200 K rather than 1 K/s to 973 K with measurements at defined temperature steps.

The claim that the mechanism is strictly limited to particles below 5 nm and that sluggish-diffusion stabilization should hold above 10 nm is unsupported and conflicts with the target's sub-10 nm boundary.
The hypothesis conflates segregation onset with evaporation onset; substantial diffusion and segregation emerge above about 673 K, whereas Au/Cu shell melting and evaporation culminate near 973 K.
